topic: Capstone Information Architecture, User Flows, and Wireframes
learningObjectives: Organize capstone content into a clear information architecture.
Design task-focused user flows for primary user goals.
Translate flows into structured low-fidelity wireframes.

activities.title: Content Structure Map
activities.instruction: Explore how content and features can be grouped into a logical hierarchy.

content.concept: Information architecture organizes content and features so users can find and understand them efficiently.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

config.principle: Group related content while keeping frequently used destinations easy to reach.

activities.title: User Flow Builder
activities.instruction: Build the shortest logical path for a user completing a primary task.

content.concept: User flows represent the sequence of actions users take to complete a specific task.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Flow Sequence Challenge
activities.instruction: Drag each screen into the correct sequence for completing a task.

content.concept: A well-structured flow reduces unnecessary steps and keeps users oriented toward their goal.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Wireframe Anatomy
activities.instruction: Identify the purpose of each region in a low-fidelity wireframe.

content.concept: Wireframes define hierarchy, structure, navigation, and content placement before visual styling.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

items.label: Navigation
items.description: Provides access to major sections and helps users understand where they are.

items.label: Page Title
items.description: Clearly communicates the purpose of the current screen.

items.label: Primary Content
items.description: Contains the information or controls needed to complete the task.

items.label: Primary Action
items.description: Represents the main action users are expected to take.

items.label: Supporting Information
items.description: Provides additional context without competing with the primary task.
